briefing.headline: OpenAI o4-preview and Google Gemini 3.0 accelerate AGI race as compute shortages intensify

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs released multiple new models this month amid record funding. The AGI timeline debate has intensified with several labs claiming substantial capability jumps. National security concerns are rising around model proliferation.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI launched o4-preview with advanced reasoning. Anthropic released Claude 4 Opus while Meta open-sourced Llama 4. DeepSeek R2 achieved competitive performance at lower cost.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New EU AI Act enforcement guidelines were published yesterday.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA announced Blackwell Ultra shipments ramping. Microsoft and Google both broke ground on new $10B+ data center clusters in Texas and Arizona.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first AGI system be developed by a US or Chinese lab?
